letter.company: Consolidated Power Projects Australia Pty Ltd
letter.company_line: CPP designs, builds, commissions and maintains substations, transmission lines, wind farms and battery storage systems, with an in-house design team across electrical, civil, structural and SCADA disciplines.
letter.subject: Trainee Drafter, Substations, Adelaide (SEEK 95398302)
paragraphs: I saw your Trainee Drafter (Substations) advert on SEEK. You welcome people who have recently completed drafting studies in civil or structural, and I finished my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, so I am applying.

At Albright Institute I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, wrote site reports and kept progress and material records, so I know how drawings get used once they reach site.

I have not drafted electrical or substation work yet, and your advert says that is not essential, so I would start as a trainee and learn your primary design standards from your drafters and engineers. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide. I have a White Card, a driver's licence and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.

checklist: Confirm with Marc that he is willing to discuss relocating to Adelaide before applying
Check Gmail again for any new conpower.com.au or Consolidated Power Projects receipt, then open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95398302 and confirm it is still open
Apply through the employer link from SEEK with the master resume and the saved cover letter PDF (applications are not accepted by email)
Answer any portal questions from facts only; do not claim electrical or substation drafting experience; note the earlier unsuccessful Graduate Engineer applications (March to April 2026) if asked
Note the receipt date in /workspace/job-finds (tracker recording is paused)
notes: Direct employer advert on SEEK (link out to CPP's own application page). Adelaide role; relocation to be confirmed by Marc.
